page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number 15 at top right. Catchword "justo" at bottom right. Signature "C 2" at bottom centre.

main_text.l: ut non mancipet suum judicium cæca
mente, ut dictatoris edictis, sed ipse
mine, tum suo, tum ex Divina revela-
quod sibi videtur bonum & æquum. At
in regno Christi naturali, potestate illa
mina, semel e medio sublata, solus
ri gladio, constat vis & ratio legum,
constabit Papæ in hoc regno naturali
intra sui imperii pomeria, tam Christi
Vicario, quam Sultano intra sui impe-
in quo, quod dives est, & magnificum,

l.i: ut loquitur Tacitus, habetur pro bono, justo

page.notes: Woodcut-free page. Some words in the text are faint or damaged; "Ipsaque", "lumbifragium" and "Sorbonista" read as printed. The final line is partly under the catchword area; "justo" is treated as catchword.
